criteria.label: Account name
criteria.fullCredit: Clearly identifies the account and its audience without relying on unsupported search claims.

criteria.label: Handle and identity
criteria.fullCredit: Handle, avatar, and visible name make the same organization recognizable.

criteria.label: Audience
criteria.fullCredit: States who benefits, such as people working or job hunting across the Ticino–Italy border.

criteria.label: Practical value
criteria.fullCredit: Names the kinds of verified, useful information the account publishes.

criteria.label: Trust and evidence
criteria.fullCredit: Uses only verifiable organization details and links to authoritative site sources.

criteria.label: Primary destination
criteria.fullCredit: The visible link reaches the current canonical page that best matches the profile promise.

criteria.label: Pinned posts
criteria.fullCredit: Visible pins answer distinct first-visit needs with current, source-backed content.

criteria.label: Highlights
criteria.fullCredit: Visible highlights are named clearly, current, and useful to the account's audience.

criteria.label: Cover clarity
criteria.fullCredit: Visible covers are legible at profile size and distinguish recurring content types.

criteria.label: Language and local fit
criteria.fullCredit: Italian-first wording is natural and local; other languages appear only when the account can serve them.

criteria.label: Accessibility
criteria.fullCredit: Visible text is readable and image meaning is not carried by color alone.

criteria.label: Next action
criteria.fullCredit: One clear next action matches a destination or interaction the account can fulfill.
